integrity: The conclusion is proved from exact residue-pair invariance, the source bifurcation criterion, and a Fredholm range argument. A finite residue enumeration is only a sanity check and is not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the one-dimensional cosine-Fourier Ohta--Kawasaki and SKT settings with a simple kernel.
A Fredholm-index-zero restriction on the doubled nonsymmetric residue sector is assumed when that sector is distinct from the symmetric and critical sectors.
The exceptional congruence permits but does not force transcriticality; two-dimensional symmetry lattices are not classified.
title: Modulo-three selection rule for one-dimensional cyclic symmetry breaking
